placements.title: Extraction leaves the call: the receipt returns at once and the work is watched after it
placements.frame: When a remember call returns only a receipt, what must the system keep so the extraction can still be watched, collected, and finished from a cursor, without the client's receipt being the only handle on the work?
placements.why: Both segments answer how a client follows a remember extraction once the call has returned. src-1 ratifies the contract: a receipt in seconds, progress watched by polling a cursor, no blocking call, and no lost work if the receipt is dropped. src-2 names the two observation paths that follow a dispatch: polling the run, or the reaction piggybacked on a later call. This is a recurring subject that future envelopes on async work will keep feeding, so it earns a theme leaf rather than a fact leaf. No existing leaf is present in the supplied structure, so nothing is reused. Foundational, so no under.
